'''Sulaan''' was a Morat'to'raken in the [[Seanchan]] army
==Activities==

She was the Morat'to'raken who takes [[Mat]] and [[Olver]] to the [[Valley of Thakan'dar]] on [[Dhana]]. An arrow from the battle below grazes her and knocks her unconscious, forcing Mat to land himself. Mat thinks her a pretty woman, but insane{{Ref/book|14|45}}.
